decisions.reason: Drop because its disappearance from the 2024 website suggests weak traction, and in a product area the firm knows well it can read that signal reliably and reallocate capacity to stronger display lines.

Drop because an online customer portal is relatively far from the firm's paper-display knowledge base, so its absorptive capacity for improving and commercialising it is weaker than for core physical solutions.

Keep because it builds directly on the firm's core cardboard-display capabilities and the 2024 German Packaging Award is strong evidence that the firm can learn from and scale this concept commercially.
Keep because it is very close to the established display business, giving the firm strong capability to refine it through its existing design, production, testing and logistics know-how.
Keep because the small cardboard counter display fits the firm's core competence and broadens its 3D cardboard range with low knowledge distance and good scope for incremental improvement.

Keep because the large freestanding cardboard information display is a natural extension of the firm's established offer and can be supported by its integrated manufacturing and assembly capabilities.
